reason: The action stands: no submit, exp70g stays unsubmitted, finals {#37,#38} untouched, and the only output is an information line, so R1-R10 and R8 are met trivially. The core fact is solid. Probe 41 (0.954 -> 0.949, dummy forks 75 -> 55, measured on K2) overturns 'division knobs are invisible on public' for the DeepCenter safe-division threshold above 0.25, and the lab (+0.0013 on 6bba) got the sign wrong. The cap-6 closure also holds on magnitude alone. exp48 shows 4/1/4/4 (cap binds on 3 of 4 clips), so cap 6 adds at most 6 dummy forks. At most 0.00015 per insertion fork, taken from the +0.001 displays of #35-#34 and #37-#38, that is at most +0.0009, central ~0 because the added forks rank lower. However, the calibration line as written has three defects. (a) The 'x138 average 0.00058-0.00065 per fork' mixes bases. Its numerator, 0.036-0.040, comes from probe 26 (exp29 minus all forks = 0.911). Its denominator, 62, is x138's dummy fork count. exp29's dummy fork count was never recorded, and x138 with zero forks was never probed, so this is an order-of-magnitude guess, not a measurement. (b) Point (3), 'the exp60 lab does not set the sign of ANY division knob', rests on n=1. The lab and public agreed in sign for the insertion (lab +0.0019 CONFIRMATION, public +0.001). Point (2) also still uses the lab marginal (0 TP / 4 FP / 81 unannotated) to justify the closure, so (2) and (3) contradict each other as written. (c) Per-fork value varies a lot between fork types: DC band ~0.00025, insertion ~0.00008, and probe 20's DivNet-vetoed candidates ~0 (tie, replaced by next candidates). So a single 'per-dummy-fork public value' must never be used as a linear multiplier for other knobs. Probes 43/44 (DC 0.20/0.225, +21/+13 dummy forks) score around 12:30-13:00Z today and will add two points, so the line is provisional until then. Still, none of this changes the decision.
fix: Write the ROUND 15 RECORD line as follows. Per-fork value differs by band; do not extrapolate linearly. The exp60 lab missed the sign for the DC threshold (n=1) and matched it for the insertion (n=1), so it is not a reliable sign source for division knobs.' Curator correction: 'division knobs invisible on public' is WRONG for DC-gated safe divisions above 0.25 and still RIGHT, as far as we know, for insertion, cap and veto forks (probes 20, 35, 37/38). After 43/44 score, add their per-fork values or ties to the same line.
realistic_gain: 0 on public and private: this is bookkeeping and changes no submission. Its value is that it stops a future decision from using a wrong per-fork multiplier or trusting the lab's sign on a division knob. That matters only for post-deadline lessons, since the finals pair is fixed.
